summary_en: FY3/27 dividend raised to 80 yen/share (intermediate 40 yen, year-end 40 yen) from prior forecast of 76 yen/share (intermediate 38 yen, year-end 38 yen). Payout ratio 40.4% against raised full-year earnings guidance. Increase driven by upward revision of net income (+6.0% to 53.0 billion yen) following earlier-than-expected June policy rate hike.
title_en: Notice Regarding Upward Revision of FY3/27 H2 (Cumulative) and Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Daishi Hokuetsu Financial Group raised its FY3/27 dividend forecast on 31 July 2026. The interim (second-quarter) dividend and year-end dividend were each increased by 2 yen to 40 yen per share, bringing the full-year total to 80 yen from the prior forecast of 76 yen per share. The increase follows an upward revision of full-year net income attributable to parent company shareholders by 6.0% to 53.0 billion yen, driven principally by an earlier-than-expected domestic policy rate hike from 0.75% to 1.00% that occurred in June 2026 (the prior forecast had assumed this would occur in December). The higher rate environment lifted fund income from lending and securities above initial expectations. At the new dividend level, the payout ratio is 40.4% against revised earnings. The company notes that the revised earnings forecast assumes the policy rate remains at 1.00% and that further adjustments may occur depending on future rate movements and earnings progress.
